channel.title: Void News: The Argument
channel.description: The Sunday edition of Void News, read by three voices. The week's cover story, then the two columnists who disagree about it, reading their own published words at each other across a held pause. Then what each of them leaves out, the week's coverage measured, and the question it leaves open. No ads. No paywall.
